name: Shillien Elder
notes: Party HEALER and the party's Stigma debuffer. Owner rule: healers ONLY heal. Allowed: heals and the HoT, Recharge and the MP tools, cleanses, Stigma of Shilien, optionally Block Shield on RBs and Blessed Blood on the tank. Everything else (nukes, Inquisitor, root/sleep spam, board buffs) is not auto in party.

Recharge 1013 [dp]: 6 s cast, 400 range; it cannot target a class that itself has Recharge (other Elders, Saints or Oracles). The Shillien Knight tank is a priority Recharge target (Guard Stance, Shield Fortress, Fortitude and the hate skills drain its MP).
Heal and Recharge priority, top down = row order.
Greater Heal 1217 and Greater Group Heal 1219 [dp]: instant heal plus a 15 s HoT, both LIFE_FORCE_OTHERS (their HoTs replace each other on the same target); 5 s and 7 s cast.

Stigma of Shilien 1539 [dp]: 100% application; 30 s; target takes +16/24/32/40% damage from SWORD, BLUNT, DAGGER, DUAL and DUALFIST weapons (nothing for bows or magic); 600-900 range; 1.5 s cast; 3 s reuse; hate only -1 (l2-servera's "provokes" claim is contradicted by the datapack).

rows.trig: Prio 1. Any member HP < 35%, or tank < 45% and dropping. Fast panic heal.

when.text: not while its HoT is still on most of the party

rows.trig: Prio 2. From 48. 3+ members < 70%. Don't recast while its 15 s HoT is still on most of the party.
Prio 3. Tank < 75%, or a single member < 65%. Default single heal. Its HoT means one cast per target per ~15 s is often enough.

when.text: at the pull, and again when it ends

rows.trig: Prio 4. On the tank just before or at the pull, and again when it ends. Party only; 15 s; 20 s reuse. While it lasts, hits of >= 60 damage have a 60% chance to proc a heal.

when.text: tank or caster MP < 50% (tank first under 30%); only when every HP > 70%

rows.trig: Prio 5. MP: tank or caster < 50% (tank first if it is under 30%). Only when every HP > 70%, because of the 6 s cast.

when.text: a member is paralyzed, poisoned or bleeding

rows.trig: Prio 6. From 44. A member is paralyzed, poisoned or bleeding (for a paralyzed tank: immediately).

when.text: a member is poisoned (cast on that member)

rows.trig: Prio 6. Poison only.

when.text: every HP > 70% and melee DPS present; never pick its own target

rows.trig: Prio 7. Debuff duty: on the tank's target (assist the tank, never pick its own target). Only when every HP > 70%, the target is a big mob, champion or RB (HP above ~3x a normal mob), and melee DPS is present. Reapply when it expires (30 s). Linedia says it "finally becomes worth using" from skill level 3, roughly level 61+.
rows.why: allowed for the healer: Stigma on the tank's target (owner rule exception)
